transcript: My name is Bihumi Fernando. I am a recent computing graduate preparing for its support and general. I practiced ticketing, Windows troubleshooting, and network basics. I worked on a student management system for education. My part was student records. The issue was unclear requirements. The system reduced duplicate records. I want to improve my skills.
feedback: You could have explained your role in the student management system more clearly. For example, you could have mentioned how you worked with the team to implement the system and how it benefited the students.
strengths: practiced ticketing, Windows troubleshooting, and network basics
weaknesses: lack of clarity on project requirements
suggestions: be more specific about your role and responsibilities
explain how your skills align with the job requirements
better_answer_example: I worked on a student management system for education, where I was responsible for developing the student records module. I collaborated with the team to ensure the system met the requirements and reduced duplicate records. This experience has helped me develop my problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
